blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training requires global load balance to prevent expert under-utilization and local balance for efficient expert-parallel execution. Existing distributed Quantile Balancing (QB) uses shard-dependent or approximate global quantiles, while token-independent expert biases cannot ensure microbatch-level balance. We introduce Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB), which computes exact global-batch BF16 quantiles with negligible communication, and Load-Error Injection (LEI), which injects local load errors directly into router-score gradients. On 7.5B-parameter MoEs trained for up to 500B tokens, EQB improves global balance and downstream performance over naive QB, while LEI improves local balance and outperforms the GShard loss at comparable quality.
blocks.zh: 专家混合培训需要全球负载平衡,以防止专家利用不足和当地平衡,从而高效率地进行专家平行执行。 现有的分布式量子平衡(QB)使用硬性依赖或近似全球量子,而象征性的独立专家偏差不能确保微批量平衡. 我们引入Exact Quantile Balance(EQB),它计算出精确的全局批量BF16 quantiles,通信可忽略不计,以及load-Error Injection(LEI),它直接将本地负载错误注入路由器-积分梯度. 7.5B参数 接受最多500B令牌训练的MOE,EQB比天真QB改善了全球平衡和下游性能,而LEI则改善了本地平衡,并在相当质量上超过了GShard损失.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Sparse MoE models increase parameter capacity without proportionally increasing per-token compute by routing each token to only few experts ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . Realizing this benefit requires balancing expert load at two scales. Global balance , measured over all tokens in an optimizer step, prevents routing from persistently concentrating on a small subset of experts. Local balance within an expert-parallel (EP) microbatch reduces load skew, improving dispatch and expert-compute efficiency. These objectives are distinct: imbalances across local microbatches can cancel when aggregated over an optimizer step, so global balance does not imply local balance.
blocks.zh: Sparse MOE模型在不按比例增加每吨计算量的情况下,通过将每个符号的路由给只有少数专家来增加参数容量(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年). 实现这一效益需要在两个尺度上平衡专家的工作量。 全球平衡(Global election), 以更优化的步骤衡量所有标志, 专家-平行(EP)微批内的局部平衡会减少负载skew,提高调度和专家计算效率. 这些目标是截然不同的:在通过更优化的步骤进行汇总时,各地方微管之间的不平衡可以消除,因此全球平衡并不意味着地方平衡。

blocks.en: Quantile Balancing (QB) ( Su, 2026 ) controls global load through token-independent expert biases computed from routing-margin quantiles, requiring neither an auxiliary loss nor a controller learning rate. In distributed training, however, the required global-batch quantile is not available on any individual data-parallel rank. Su (2026) ; Dial (2026) average rank-local quantiles, yielding a statistic that depends on how the batch is partitioned. Kimi Team (2026) instead aggregate a global histogram, making the estimate partition invariant but limiting its accuracy to the chosen histogram resolution. We introduce Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB), which applies two-pass BF16 radix selection to recover the exact global-batch empirical quantile using two 256-bin all-reduces per layer.
blocks.zh: 量子平衡(QB)(Su, 2026)通过由路由-边距方块计算出来的象征性独立专家偏差控制全球负载,不要求辅助损失或控制器学习率. 然而,在分布式培训中,没有任何个人数据平行等级的所需全球批量。 Su (2026); Dial (2026) 平均军衔-当地量级,得出一个取决于批量如何划分的统计数据. Kimi Team (2026) 转而聚合一个全局直方图,使得估计分区变异,但将其精确度限制在选定的直方图分辨率. 我们采用精确的量子平衡(EQB),它采用双路BF16光度选择,利用每层2个256-宾式全减量来回收精确的全球批量经验量子。

blocks.en: Exact global balancing does not solve local imbalance. A single expert bias is shared across microbatches and cannot adapt to their routing distributions. The GShard auxiliary loss ( Lepikhin et al., 2021 ) provides a local training signal, but propagates the load error through normalized routing probabilities, coupling the correction across experts and using a soft surrogate that can change without changing hard top- K K assignments. We introduce Load-Error Injection (LEI), which instead passes each expert’s local load error directly to its router-score gradients. Across our experiments, EQB improves global balance over rank-averaged QB, while LEI improves local balance over the GShard loss at comparable model quality and can improve local balance and average accuracy together. Together, EQB and LEI provide complementary control of global and local MoE load balance.
blocks.zh: 精确的全球平衡并不能解决局部的不平衡. 单一的专家偏差在微管之间共享,无法适应其路径分布. GShard辅助损失(Lepikhin等人,2021年)提供了一个本地的训练信号,但通过正常的路由概率来传播负载误差,将校正在专家之间连结起来,并使用一个软代位,可以在不改变硬顶-K K任务的情况下改变. 我们引入 Load-Error Injection(LEI),它将每个专家的本地负载错误直接传递到它的路由器-分数梯度上. 在整个实验中,EQB改善了全球平衡而不是排名平均QB,而LEI则以可比的模型质量改善了本地平衡而不是GShard损失,可以共同改善本地平衡和平均准确度. EQB和LEI共同为全球和当地的MOE负载平衡提供了互补控制.

blocks.en: 3 Exact Quantile Balancing
blocks.zh: 3 精确的量化平衡

blocks.en: The goal of this section is to introduce a distributed, exact quantile balancing methodology. The QB update requires knowing the r r -th smallest routing margin for each expert, where r = T ​ K / E r=TK/E for a global batch of T T tokens. A direct distributed implementation could gather all token-level margins across data-parallel ranks, but its communication grows with T T . Alternatively, following the idea of Kimi Team (2026) , one could utilize an exact histogram over BF16 values, however, this would require up to 2 16 2^{16} bins per expert.

blocks.en: We introduce EQB by adapting radix selection ( Alabi et al., 2012 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , which locates an order statistic by successively histogramming groups of key bits and retaining the target bin. Unlike radix top- k k , EQB only requires the resulting pivot.

blocks.en: We require one global order statistic per expert from margins sharded across data-parallel ranks. We exploit the 16-bit BF16 representation and use an 8-bit radix, reducing selection to exactly two passes over a high and a low byte. Each rank forms 256-bin counts locally, and an all-reduce locates the target bin globally. EQB never materializes a smaller candidate array: the second pass simply rescans local margins whose high byte matches the selected bin. Thus, token-level margins remain local while the exact global-batch quantile is recovered with communication independent of T T .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: EQB and LEI address complementary scales of MoE load balancing. EQB recovers the exact global-batch quantile with token-count-independent communication, while LEI injects local load residuals directly into router-score gradients. EQB improves on rank-averaged QB, and LEI improves balance over the GShard loss at comparable quality. Bounding the injected residual preserves this improvement without attention-logit instability.
blocks.zh: EQB和LEI处理教育部负荷平衡的补充尺度。 EQB通过符号计数独立通信恢复精确的全局批量量,而LEI则直接将本地负载残基注入路由器-积分梯度. EQB在排名平均QB上有所改进,LEI在相当质量上改善了GShard损失的平衡. 将注射的残留物围起来可以保持这种改善,而不会引起注意和引起不安。

blocks.en: Our results use one model scale and seed, without estimating variance. GShard and LEI use separately tuned coefficients because the same coefficient produces very different router-gradient magnitudes. Local MaxVio is a proxy for dispatch cost rather than measured EP throughput.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果使用一个模型尺度和种子,没有估计差异。 GShard和LEI分别使用调谐系数,因为同一个系数会产生非常不同的路由器级数. 本地的MaxVio是调度成本的代称,而不是测量EP吞吐量.

blocks.en: Appendix A Related work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: Sparse MoE systems commonly encourage balanced routing with an auxiliary objective. The GShard loss [ Lepikhin et al., 2021 ] couples hard expert loads to mean routing probabilities, and Switch Transformer [ Fedus et al., 2022 ] uses a closely related objective. Wang et al. [2024] instead introduce an auxiliary-loss-free controller that updates expert-selection biases from observed loads but requires a tuned step size; DeepSeek-V3 later adopts this strategy [ DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ] . These approaches motivate our separation between global bias control and local score-side correction.
blocks.zh: Sparse MOE系统通常鼓励具有辅助目标的平衡路由. GShard损失[Lepikhin等人,2021年]夫妇硬专家负载指路由概率,Switch Transformer[Fedus等人,2022年]使用一个密切相关的目标. 王等编. [2024]转而引入一个辅助无损失控制器,从观测到的负载中更新专家选取偏差,但需要调制的步码大小; DeepSeek-V3后来采用了这个策略[DeepSeek-AI, 2024]. 这些办法促使我们把全球偏见控制与当地得分面校正区分开来。

blocks.en: QB [ Su, 2026 ] derives a bias update from quantiles of the balanced-assignment problem and removes the controller learning rate. Distributed implementations differ in the statistic they aggregate: Su’s formulation and MARIN [ Dial, 2026 ] average rank-local quantiles, whereas Kimi Team [2026] estimates the global-batch quantile with an all-reduced histogram. EQB targets the same global-batch statistic exactly, while LEI complements the token-independent QB bias with a local router-score update.
blocks.zh: QB [Su, 2026] 从平衡分配问题的量子得到一个偏差更新,并取消了控制器的学习率. 所分配的执行情况在统计总数上有所不同: Su的配方和MARIN [Dial, 2026] 平均军衔-局部量级, 而Kimi Team [2026] 估计全球量级量级为全减直方图。 EQB完全针对相同的全局批量统计,而LEI则以本地路由器-分数更新来补充符号独立的QB偏差.

blocks.en: All experiments use a 7.5B-parameter decoder-only model with 0.5B active parameters per token. The model has 50 Transformer layers, with two dense layers followed by 48 MoE layers, and combines sliding-window attention (SWA) with full attention in a 4:1 ratio. Each MoE layer contains E = 256 E=256 routed experts with K = 6 K=6 active experts per token, plus one shared expert. We use sigmoid routing with the expert bias applied to the router logits, a 128k vocabulary, and sequence length 16,384.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用7.5B参数的解码器专用模型,每个符号有0.5B活性参数. 该模型有50个变形器层,有两个密集层,后面是48个MOE层,将滑窗注意力(SWA)与全注意力结合起来,以4:1的比例. 每个MOE层包含E = 256 E = 256位路由专家,每枚信物有K = 6 K = 6位活跃专家,外加1位共享专家. 我们使用Sigmoid的路由方式,其专家偏差适用于路由器对数,一个128k的词汇,序列长度为16,384.

blocks.en: The six 100B-token ablations use 64 data-parallel ranks, a global batch size of 576 sequences, and a warmup-stable learning-rate schedule. Each run trains for 10,342 optimizer steps. To evaluate the balance–quality trade-off over a longer horizon, we additionally train EQB and normalized LEI variants for 500B tokens.
